derivations.epistemic_behavior: Mechanical filter; no epistemic dispositions. Open status is world-observable from billing sources.
derivations.completeness_assumptions: COMPLETE over invoice_record universe: every invoice row is enumerated and status is recorded.
derivations.deterministic_computation: SELECT invoice_id FROM invoice_record WHERE status = 'open'

derivations.epistemic_behavior: Purpose A policy filter; no unresolved disposition on membership itself.
derivations.completeness_assumptions: COMPLETE over contract_record: all governing documents in the data room are compiled.
derivations.deterministic_computation: Include contract_id when document_kind is not an expired SOW (exclude SOW with non-empty expiry_date indicating past non-renewal).
derivations.required_premise: contract_record.document_kind and expiry_date are mechanically extracted from contract headers.

derivations.epistemic_behavior: Purpose C non-expired rule; continuing-term inference may consult obligation_kind_attribution for auto_renewal or rolling_term but expiry_date absence is the primary gate.
derivations.deterministic_computation: Include contract_id when expiry_date is empty; exclude contracts with recorded past expiry and no continuing term.
derivations.required_premise: contract_record.expiry_date and term_description are mechanically extracted.
optional_enrichment: obligation_kind_attribution PRESENT for auto_renewal or rolling_term supports continuing-relationship prong when expiry is ambiguous
blocking_unresolved_state: obligation_kind_attribution UNRESOLVED for auto_renewal and rolling_term when expiry_date is ambiguous and continuing term cannot be read mechanically

derivations.epistemic_behavior: Candidate pair enumeration only; epistemic disposition comes from identity_judgment, not this relation.
derivations.completeness_assumptions: INCOMPLETE by design: scoped to commercially relevant CRM–contract families and registry candidates matched by deterministic first-token substring on billed or account names.
derivations.deterministic_computation: For each CRM account mapped to a governing contract via account-id prefix correspondence, emit all unordered identifier pairs (left < right) among crm:, billing:, contract:, and matching registry: candidates.
derivations.required_premise: CRM-to-contract mapping and invoice-to-contract associations are mechanically compiled.
optional_enrichment: commercial_note_record may suggest additional registry candidates or name variants but does not expand the required-link set beyond mechanical rules

derivations.epistemic_behavior: Association field maps invoice_contract_association ASSERTED to asserted and UNRESOLVED (or missing adjudication) to unresolved. Missing association does not imply non-qualification when counterparty policy is otherwise met.
derivations.completeness_assumptions: Row coverage over represented billed revenue whose governing contract is active_for_purpose_a and has at least one acquisition_relevant_condition PRESENT.
derivations.deterministic_computation: Join invoice_record to invoice_contract_association and active_contract_for_purpose_a; require acquisition_relevant_condition PRESENT on contract_id; emit association from invoice_contract_association disposition or unresolved when join not adjudicated.
required_premise: active_contract_for_purpose_a membership for the governing contract
acquisition_relevant_condition PRESENT for at least one allowed condition_kind on that contract
optional_enrichment: identity_judgment may inform invoice_contract_association adjudication upstream but does not block inclusion when association is explicitly unresolved
blocking_unresolved_state: acquisition_relevant_condition UNRESOLVED for all candidate kinds on an otherwise active contract blocks positive qualification of that contract for inclusion
non_blocking_unresolved_state: invoice_contract_association UNRESOLVED: invoice row is still emitted with association unresolved per purpose A omission ban
identity_judgment UNRESOLVED across billing and contract identifiers does not block inclusion when invoice_contract_association is ASSERTED

derivations.epistemic_behavior: Status dependent only when both prongs satisfied and identity chain has no UNRESOLVED links among counterparty, contract, and CRM identifiers for the relationship. DISTINCT is a resolved negative, not blocking.
derivations.completeness_assumptions: Row coverage over counterparty-contract candidates with active contract or open-invoice-backed current relationship and at least one candidate obligation kind.
derivations.deterministic_computation: For each active_contract_for_purpose_c row with PRESENT obligation_kind in {exclusivity, auto_renewal, rolling_term} and current relationship (open invoice on contract OR PRESENT auto_renewal/rolling_term), emit row; status dependent unless any required identity link in the commercial chain is UNRESOLVED.
required_premise: current_commercial_relationship: open_invoice linked to contract OR obligation_kind_attribution PRESENT for auto_renewal or rolling_term
obligation_kind_attribution PRESENT for at least one of exclusivity, auto_renewal, rolling_term
optional_enrichment: invoice_record billed_name for counterparty identifier rendering
blocking_unresolved_state: identity_judgment UNRESOLVED between billing, contract, or CRM identifiers in the commercial chain forces status unresolved
invoice_contract_association absence or UNRESOLVED when open invoices must be joined to contract for counterparty resolution
non_blocking_unresolved_state: identity_judgment DISTINCT between identifiers: resolved negative, does not force unresolved dependency status
obligation_kind_attribution UNRESOLVED for a non-selected kind when another kind is PRESENT

derivations.epistemic_behavior: Serialize purpose_a_qualifying_invoice to contractual_revenue_exposure schema; map ASSERTED to asserted, UNRESOLVED to unresolved.
derivations.deterministic_computation: Join purpose_a_qualifying_invoice to invoice_record for field values; strip contract_id prefix; sort by invoice_id ascending.
non_blocking_unresolved_state: association unresolved rows are included, not blocked

derivations.epistemic_behavior: Emit epistemic disposition from identity_judgment grounding detail (SAME_ENTITY, DISTINCT, UNRESOLVED). Pairs without adjudication default to UNRESOLVED.
derivations.completeness_assumptions: Link coverage over required_identity_link candidate set.
derivations.deterministic_computation: Join required_identity_link to identity_judgment on (left, right); orient left < right; sort by left then right ascending.
non_blocking_unresolved_state: identity_judgment UNRESOLVED is emitted explicitly, not suppressed

derivations.epistemic_behavior: Serialize commercial_dependency_row; parse aggregated TEXT lists to JSON arrays; map status dependent or unresolved.
derivations.deterministic_computation: Render counterparty and contract_id; split open_invoice_ids and obligation_kinds on comma; strip prefixes; sort obligation_kinds ascending; sort rows by contract_id ascending.
non_blocking_unresolved_state: status unresolved rows are included per purpose C unresolved-over-false policy

acquisition_relevant_condition.reason: PURPOSE-admitted relation excluded from 06_world/world.sqlite per P6 admission policy; ACCEPT maps to PRESENT, REJECT to NOT_PRESENT.
acquisition_relevant_condition.limitation: No acquisition_relevant_condition UNRESOLVED tuples were adjudicated; contracts without ACCEPT for any kind are excluded from purpose A qualification.

limitations: 06_world/world.sqlite lacks invoice_contract_association UNRESOLVED tuples; purpose A association unresolved path is structurally supported but not exercised on current data.
identity_judgment dispositions are read from assertion grounding detail, not a TEXT role on the relation tuple.
open_invoice derivation is pre-registered in world.sqlite from an earlier pass; derive_purposes.py recomputes purpose-scoped derivations without mutating world state.
